plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 25% of the book, to favor income and broad index exposure.
Increase QQQ to 20% of the book, further favoring broad index exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings, but will likely see lower growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Buy VST, targeting 4% of the book, based on its strong scanner setup.
Buy TECL, targeting 4% of the book, based on its strong scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth by blending broad index exposure with quality tech and a small amount of leverage. It focuses on risk-first growth, with moderate drawdown potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, targeting 6% of the book, to increase leveraged exposure.
Add to SPAL, targeting 6% of the book, to increase leveraged exposure.
Buy VST, targeting 6% of the book, leveraging a top scanner setup.
Buy TECL, targeting 6% of the book, leveraging another strong scanner setup.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by using and adding leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing, which can lead to rapid losses without strict stop discipline.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize income.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth-oriented exposure.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions with lower drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for steady distributions. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
